description: This source file defines a SwiftUI view called 'AgentEventsWindow' that displays a list of agent event logs, including their details and JSON data rendering. It also defines a supporting private view 'EventRow' for individual event display and a PreviewProvider for SwiftUI previews.

classes.name: AgentEventsWindow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view displaying a window with agent events list, including a 'Clear' button and a list of events.

classes.name: EventRow
classes.description: A private SwiftUI view representing an individual event row with formatted timestamp, stream type, run ID, and JSON data.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout of the AgentEventsWindow, including title, button, and events list.

methods.name: tint
methods.description: Determines the color associated with the event's stream type.

methods.name: formattedTs
methods.description: Formats the event timestamp into a human-readable string.

methods.name: prettyJSON
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of data into a pretty-printed JSON string, if possible.
